cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - PenHolderBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
PenHolderBox: Open pen holder box with two internal grid plates.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes PenHolderBox --bottom_edge e --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes PenHolderBox --bottom_edge --reference
